title: Parts of a Plant Song | Grade 1 Science for Kids | Little Takhti
description:
Sing along with Takhti! A song about the parts of a plant: roots, stem, leaves and flowers, the parts we eat, and what plants need to grow. Then try a quick quiz. For Grade 1 children (ages 6 to 7).

Free printable worksheets, quizzes and games for this topic: https://littletakhti.netlify.app/class-1-science-parts-of-a-plant-worksheets/

Chapters
0:00 The song
2:02 Quiz
2:47 Remember

Little Takhti makes free learning for children in Pakistan, Nursery to Grade 3. https://littletakhti.netlify.app
